    <title>@astrojs/vue@7.0.3</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17985" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17985/hovercard">#17985</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/7a6e7f7174147e38731e39378e6f5b294834d207"><code>7a6e7f7</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/apps/astro-factory">@astro-factory</a>! - Fixes Vue render-function components failing to build when <code>@astrojs/react</code> is also enabled. React's renderer <code>check</code> no longer crashes on non-React object components, and Vue's <code>check</code> now recognizes <code>defineComponent()</code> components that use a <code>setup</code> function returning a render function.</li>
</ul></content>

    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17985" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17985/hovercard">#17985</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/7a6e7f7174147e38731e39378e6f5b294834d207"><code>7a6e7f7</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/apps/astro-factory">@astro-factory</a>! - Fixes Vue render-function components failing to build when <code>@astrojs/react</code> is also enabled. React's renderer <code>check</code> no longer crashes on non-React object components, and Vue's <code>check</code> now recognizes <code>defineComponent()</code> components that use a <code>setup</code> function returning a render function.</li>

    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17971" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17971/hovercard">#17971</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/0037c1a958a33dbf9d07d72e69b97dce910f9452"><code>0037c1a</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Fixes aborted request bodies causing duplicate unhandled rejection logs in standalone mode when using <code>src/fetch.ts</code></p>

<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17964" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17964/hovercard">#17964</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/01395b88e37ba39550f5f48e2d8374d0fa2cac8a"><code>01395b8</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/apps/astro-factory">@astro-factory</a>! - Fixes trailing-slash redirects truncating query strings that contain a second <code>?</code> character</p>
</li>
</ul></content>

    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/348060227/@astrojs/language-server@2.17.0</id>
    <updated>2026-09-16T19:39:26Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/releases/tag/%40astrojs%2Flanguage-server%402.17.0"/>
    <title>@astrojs/language-server@2.17.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Minor Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17676" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17676/hovercard">#17676</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/49d429480c7399bcebcb3b24fd37893403cfbf1b"><code>49d4294</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/Princesseuh">@Princesseuh</a>! - Improves type checking and editor support for <code>.astro</code> files.</p>
<p>The language server now uses our all-new Biome powered <code>astro2tsx</code> implementation. This new version has much better support for incomplete syntax, generic types and various edge cases.</p>
<p>In the vast majority of cases, no changes should be required to your code, and any change should be the result of more accurate types or behavior.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17542" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17542/hovercard">#17542</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/fae64ddfc344e2fbe4d1610465c75bbe0604ba77"><code>fae64dd</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/IAmYhvr">@IAmYhvr</a>! - Fixes the AstroComponent suffix not being removed from Svelte and Vue imports in <code>.astro</code> files.</li>
</ul></content>
    <author>
      <name>astrobot-houston</name>
    </author>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/348060227/@astrojs/cloudflare@14.3.2</id>
    <updated>2026-09-16T20:36:21Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/releases/tag/%40astrojs%2Fcloudflare%4014.3.2"/>
    <title>@astrojs/cloudflare@14.3.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17958" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17958/hovercard">#17958</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/b95c574b2ef5ab5541888a860aad5bf2d3a765ea"><code>b95c574</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/apps/astro-factory">@astro-factory</a>! - Fixes a build failure when the wrangler config uses the <code>exports</code> field to declare Durable Object classes</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18022" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/18022/hovercard">#18022</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/24946f745a6fc1e85b8ae271322a1a35b24a4857"><code>24946f7</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Fixes cold <code>astro dev</code> crashes when using the passthrough image service</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17842" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17842/hovercard">#17842</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/d68db7311132083dabee85e87a323542249f5228"><code>d68db73</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/adamchal">@adamchal</a>! - Fixes broken images on static sites by transforming prerendered images at build time with the default Cloudflare Images binding</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17945" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17945/hovercard">#17945</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/750b4dbe238f2a2b979503ffd780f46d19174ccb"><code>750b4db</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Pre-bundles renderer server entrypoints and the default console logger during dev so they are included in the initial optimization pass, preventing a mid-request re-optimization that could crash the dev server on Cloudflare (workerd).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Updated dependencies []:</p>
<ul>
<li>@astrojs/underscore-redirects@1.0.4</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></content>

    <title>astro-vscode@2.17.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Minor Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17676" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17676/hovercard">#17676</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/49d429480c7399bcebcb3b24fd37893403cfbf1b"><code>49d4294</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/Princesseuh">@Princesseuh</a>! - Improves type checking and editor support for <code>.astro</code> files.</p>
<p>The language server now uses our all-new Biome powered <code>astro2tsx</code> implementation. This new version has much better support for incomplete syntax, generic types and various edge cases.</p>
<p>In the vast majority of cases, no changes should be required to your code, and any change should be the result of more accurate types or behavior.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17916" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17916/hovercard">#17916</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/8eaa4f21e001293f15957daebc3b2486a5aa681d"><code>8eaa4f2</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Fixes organize imports across frontmatter and multiple script tags</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17542" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17542/hovercard">#17542</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/fae64ddfc344e2fbe4d1610465c75bbe0604ba77"><code>fae64dd</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/IAmYhvr">@IAmYhvr</a>! - Fixes the AstroComponent suffix not being removed from Svelte and Vue imports in <code>.astro</code> files.</p>
</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/348060227/astro@7.3.3</id>
    <updated>2026-09-16T19:39:20Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/releases/tag/astro%407.3.3"/>
    <title>astro@7.3.3</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17651" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17651/hovercard">#17651</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/504333c2a0c7da3ca06e39ce37eee832192ba8ea"><code>504333c</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/sxzz">@sxzz</a>! - Refactors internal version handling to use a smaller, ESM-native dependency</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17942" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17942/hovercard">#17942</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/0bc5715a2990a84598a064ac8de52c08fffd1186"><code>0bc5715</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Returns appropriate 400 and 404 responses from the image endpoint for invalid and missing local image paths</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17700" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17700/hovercard">#17700</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/b2222fc3cdbeb1b75029a109d13d19515e5260ae"><code>b2222fc</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/winklemad">@winklemad</a>! - Fixes <code>Astro.preferredLocaleList</code> returning an empty list when a locale is configured with the object form (<code>{ path, codes }</code>) and the browser sends the code with different casing or an underscore, such as <code>en-US</code> matching a configured <code>en-us</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17941" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17941/hovercard">#17941</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/394ff79954e5822e3884947a07d84fef0c72f31c"><code>394ff79</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Fixes <code>astro preview --ignore-lock</code> (and <code>astro dev --ignore-lock</code>) being refused when run from an AI agent environment. The flag now starts the server in the foreground instead of erroring, since agent detection only inferred background mode and was never explicitly requested. An explicit <code>--background</code> combined with <code>--ignore-lock</code> still errors.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17928" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17928/hovercard">#17928</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/327792719475cf5b0023dd8983cfd0dc58070888"><code>3277927</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/ArmandPhilippot">@ArmandPhilippot</a>! - Fixes TypeScript autocompletion for <code>getImage()</code> to suggest all available predefined options.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17928" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17928/hovercard">#17928</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/327792719475cf5b0023dd8983cfd0dc58070888"><code>3277927</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/ArmandPhilippot">@ArmandPhilippot</a>! - Fixes a type error in <code>getImage()</code> options that allowed passing both <code>widths</code> and <code>densities</code> at the same time.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17857" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17857/hovercard">#17857</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/2637ed10afd26f1f29db673616c6225eb0d848a6"><code>2637ed1</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/Princesseuh">@Princesseuh</a>! - Improves rendering performance</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17943" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17943/hovercard">#17943</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/2fc7ce98f982f45533d91b6ba5b95fce4eb54e11"><code>2fc7ce9</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Fixes a WebAssembly error when importing <code>astro:actions</code> in tests that run under <code>@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18018" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/18018/hovercard">#18018</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/1b5a234f5205995ff3a1c7707c093e49f1f601e7"><code>1b5a234</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/apps/astro-factory">@astro-factory</a>! - Fixes trailing-slash redirect response body pointing to the incoming URL instead of the redirect target. The <code>location</code> header was correct, but the HTML body (<code>&lt;meta http-equiv="refresh"&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;title&gt;</code>, and <code>&lt;a&gt;</code> tag) contained the original request path without the trailing-slash correction or query string.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17905" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17905/hovercard">#17905</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/eaf70fa3f0b5d01237d9af8110649ded2e239b5d"><code>eaf70fa</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/SudoDevStudio">@SudoDevStudio</a>! - Fixes custom dev toolbar apps losing their UI after client-side navigation with <code>&lt;ClientRouter /&gt;</code>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/18011" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/18011/hovercard">#18011</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/558b301a3626e5f0fd3ae4e3997e0c6de53e9867"><code>558b301</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/apps/astro-factory">@astro-factory</a>! - Fixes prerendered Cloudflare pages rendering as <code>[object Object]</code> when <code>nodejs_compat</code> is enabled in <code>wrangler.toml</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/pull/17944" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/withastro/astro/pull/17944/hovercard">#17944</a> <a href="https://github.com/withastro/astro/commit/ba08e35fdc306219b69428e3e1c4e5816e116956"><code>ba08e35</code></a> Thanks <a href="https://github.com/matthewp">@matthewp</a>! - Fixes a regression in <code>astro dev</code> where writes outside the module graph (for example, <code>@astrojs/cloudflare</code>'s <code>.wrangler/state</code> files) invalidated the middleware on every request, causing repeated SSR reloads. Such writes no longer invalidate the middleware.</p>
</li>
<li>
